subject: Energy
title: Air Pollution from Energy
description: A fast breakdown of Air Pollution from Energy for builders.

hook.text: Burning fossil fuels kills millions annually—air pollution from coal, oil, and gas causes 4+ million premature deaths.

buildup.text: Particulate matter (PM2.5) penetrates deep into lungs—causing heart attacks, strokes, lung cancer, and asthma.

discovery.text: Coal plants are the worst—emitting sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, mercury, and fine particles near populated areas.

twist.text: Air pollution costs are rarely priced in—hidden health damages are estimated at $2.9 trillion per year globally.

climax.text: Switching from coal to renewables delivers immediate health gains—cleaner air saves lives before climate benefits show.

punchline.text: Fossil fuels kill with smoke today—not just with warming tomorrow.

quiz.question: How many premature deaths does fossil fuel air pollution cause annually?
